standing.headline: Every return through 2025 is filed, and the HST return for 2025-26 was filed on 13 October. About $4,021.34 should come back once CRA applies the instalments.

points.label: Filed and settled
points.text: The T2 for 2023, 2024 and 2025. The T2 2025 was filed by Ejaz Pirwani on 18 May 2026 and assessed the same day: tax $13,368 against $17,960 of instalments, so CRA refunded $4,592, received with interest as $4,644.90 on 28 May. Umar's and Maham's 2025 T1 returns were filed electronically on 20 April 2026 with refunds of $22,130.37 and $40.17; no notice of assessment for either is in the folder yet.

points.label: Waiting
points.text: The HST refund for the year ending 14 August 2026. Saira filed the return on 13 October (confirmation 573643): sales $207,480, HST collected $26,972.40, ITC $4,993.74, net tax $21,978.66, with the Mercedes at 90% and the lease ITC at the full 90%. Line 110 is $0, so CRA shows $21,978.66 owing by 14 November; the $26,000 of instalments on the account should cover it and leave about $4,021.34 to refund, as happened in October 2025. Check the RT balance in early November; do not pay it.

points.label: Umar and the corporation
points.text: No dividends were paid in 2025 and there is no shareholder loan. The filed T2 2025 shows the corporation owing Umar $13,357 for business costs he paid personally. With 2026 rent at 30%, phone and insurance added, and the Mercedes personal share charged back to him, he was owed $16,111.98 on 23 September 2026 at 20% personal use. At the 10% decided on 13 October that rises to about $18,476. He can draw it tax free as expense reimbursement once Saira agrees.

points.label: Main risk
points.text: 2026 corporate tax is projected about $4,454 (at 90% Mercedes use; $4,743 at 80%) above the $10,500 of planned instalments. About $1,411 of that comes from lease payments over the s.67.3 cap and about $289 from the 10% personal share of the Mercedes no longer being deductible; the rest is simply profit. Top up instalments by about $1,186 a month from September to December, or record more director funded expenses. The Mercedes has no mileage log behind the 90% claim, and the filed T2 2025 deducted the whole lease at 100%: about $6,608 above the cap, about $9,600 if the down payment is also spread over the 36 month term.
